seo_title: Follow the Money: Tom Wan and Zack Brenner on Robinhood
meta_description: Tom Wan of Entropy Advisors reads Robinhood Chain's data and compares Robinhood with Base; Zack Brenner of OpenSea on OpenSea Mobile and social trading.
summary: Tom Wan of Entropy Advisors walks through what the data says about Robinhood Chain three months in, how the chain could add to Robinhood's revenue, and how Robinhood and Coinbase's Base are taking different routes to tokenization. Zack Brenner of OpenSea then explains OpenSea Mobile, its aggregated social trading feed and Signals, and what he expects from the next few months.
takeaways: Tom says DEX volume on Robinhood Chain has cooled from its September peak, as it has across the wider industry, while TVL has held roughly level, which he reads as longer-term capital staying.
He argues the chain is not only a fee stream: stock tokens can bring Robinhood new users and revenue, and the Q3 call would be the first time the company discusses the chain.
Comparing Robinhood and Coinbase, he notes Robinhood is both a chain operator and a stock token issuer, and that both companies are moving into tokenization and prediction markets in different ways.

On tokenization, Tom expects depegs when buying or selling volume is unusually high, and points out that pairing a volatile meme coin with a stable asset affects impermanent loss for liquidity providers.
Zack describes OpenSea Mobile as an all-in-one app that tracks everything a user owns and trades across chains, with an aggregated feed of trades from other apps and Signals for both tokens and NFTs.
